4873.title: Native image results retain non-image timeline items
4873.rootCauseOneLine: Claude and Pi retain the started non-image shape when successful native read results contain image blocks.
4873.proposedFix: Promote validated successful native image reads to existing imageView items in each provider completion translator; preserve path, identity, presentation, text reads, and failures.
4873.caveats: Translator-to-assembler classification reproduced twice; live provider delivery, browser previews, and host-file loading remain unverified. No automatic fix because this spans two separately packaged provider subsystems.
